input.title: [iOS] Keyboard opens when user moves onto a thought prior to dismissing keyboard from a note
input.body:
```
- One
- Two
```

## Step to Reproduce
1. Create Thought One and Two
2. Add a note on Thought Two
3. While the caret is on the Note, dismiss the keyboard with Done / checkmark button on Mobile Safari or tap on scroll area on Capacitor
4. Tap Thought One


## Current behavior
Keyboard open on Thought One

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e7f1316d-ad5f-4741-b0d9-e334e42b08ac

## Expected behavior
Just move the cursor onto Thought One without opening keyboard because the keyboard should only open when tapping a thought that already has the cursor.
Refer to [the standar behavior the keyboard should only open when tapping a thought that already has the cursor.](https://github.com/cybersemics/em/issues/3934#issue-4074456299)
